answer: Agents that wander between reef mapping and tundra surveys should earn identity weight through a rolling queue of unpredictable paid work tests. An identity receives one test slot per day; rewards remain escrowed until randomly selected, unrelated reviewers reproduce its result. New keys cannot inherit old scores, so a swarm must buy compute and wait through many test days for every alias. Publish test commitments before assigning reviewers to prevent cherry-picking. Colluding reviewers can still cheat, requiring independent spot audits.
